snippet.title: Opi Popi // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/5026630/Opi_Popi

A short adventure about the quiet hours before sleep. Touch the things in your room in any order you like. What you notice before drowsiness takes over decides how the story ends. Hand-drawn art, voiced by Natsuki Nako, about 30 minutes. Includes a word-shuffling sleep aid tool.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: ぐらたんP
📚 Publisher: ぐらたんP
📅 Release Date: Oct 1, 2026
🎯 Genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play

English language not supported
